evidence_class: analytical research preflight; not CI qualification and not production evidence
representation: hybrid exact semantic branches plus adaptive log-head lookup over the smooth unsaturated core
interpretation: All four adaptive representations satisfy the preregistered constitutive screen.
A fixed 401-point log-head grid fails the theta criterion for B01, O05 and O14.
Adaptive point count is strongly material-dependent: B12 needs roughly half the fixed support, while O05 and O14 need slightly more than 401 points to satisfy the same joint screen.
This supports material-specific error-controlled representation construction, but does not establish a runtime benefit.
important_design_observation: Discontinuous or branch-switched constitutive semantics must not be approximated by interpolation across the switch. The target architecture is therefore hybrid: exact cheap branch logic plus frozen adaptive approximation only within qualified smooth regions.
next_gate: F-AHL02 should compare interpolation families and point-search/runtime cost, then only the best candidate should enter end-to-end Richards replay.
